hypotheses.claim: Clicking Mark auto-recovery on a FAILED_NO_PINGS row closes the ticket but leaves verification_runs.outcome at FAILED_VERIFICATION, so the row keeps rendering 'Failed — no pings' and stays re-clickable forever, while system-efficiency (reads vr.outcome) and fleet-uptime (reads ticket.status) report the same closure two different ways.
hypotheses.strongestAlternative: Some later writer stamps the run outcome on terminal ticket closure, so the two ledgers reconcile anyway and only the optimistic UI is briefly stale.
hypotheses.altCheck: grep -rn "verificationRun\.(update|create|upsert)" apps/backend/src --include=*.ts | grep -v generated | grep -v src/verification/ -> zero hits; no writer outside the module, and inside it only the outcome:null updateMany at verification.service.ts:186

hypotheses.claim: A ZONAL_MANAGER calling GET /api/verification/fraud-flags receives fraud-flagged runs from zones outside their own — the same cross-zone read that #162 closed on GET /tickets/:id/verification.
hypotheses.strongestAlternative: A global interceptor or Prisma middleware applies zone scoping outside the service, so the missing scope arg is harmless.
hypotheses.altCheck: verification.controller.ts:111 injects no @CurrentUser at all (every other handler in the file does), and verification-query.service.ts:214 findMany where is `{ fraudFlag: true }` with no zone/ticket clause — no scope value even reaches the query layer for an interceptor to have applied

hypotheses.claim: The reason a ZM types when escalating a fraud flag appears in no report or ticket-facing screen — only in auditLog.metadata — so the compliance follow-through E-10 promises to /reports/root-cause never carries the 'why'.
hypotheses.strongestAlternative: root-cause aggregates on the TicketEvent.reasonCode rather than the audit row, so the escalation is represented downstream even if the free-text reason is not.
hypotheses.altCheck: grep -rn VERIFICATION_FRAUD_ESCALATED apps/backend/src apps/admin/src | grep -v src/verification/ -> zero hits: neither the reasonCode nor the audit action is read anywhere outside this module

hypotheses.claim: When the telemetry watermark stalls, the review row's countdown reads 'overdue' indefinitely while the sweep deliberately refuses to expire the window, giving the ZM a permanent false-overdue with no cause shown and no control to act on.
hypotheses.strongestAlternative: The page surfaces the watermark condition some other way (a staleness banner or chip) so the ZM is not actually misled.
hypotheses.altCheck: grep for watermark/telemetryAsOf/stale in VerificationReviewPage.tsx and api/verification.ts -> zero; VerificationReviewRow (api/verification.ts:23) carries no watermark or staleness field, so the page has nothing to render even if it wanted to
